market_notes.market: ETH - a level lost, but no rule triggered
market_notes.note: ETH 2,410.64 (-0.57%), $87.75, +31.8%. Its own signal improved (25 -> 35), but published work puts the critical weekly level at 2,438 - the 0.618 Fibonacci retracement - and ETH is now below it, with the stated consequence that losing 2,438 exposes the Supertrend near 2,220. That matters for our rule because 2,220 sits BELOW the 2,300 two-close exit, so on that path the exit fires on the way down rather than at the destination. The cushion has narrowed three sessions running: 7.5%, 5.4%, 4.8%. No action - the rule needs two consecutive daily CLOSES below 2,300 and we are 4.8% above. Strong counterweight: spot ETH ETFs took inflows for a TWELFTH consecutive day on Sept 2, and July was ETH's best ETF month on record ($365m) against Bitcoin's worst ($205m), with institutional flow into ETH products running at more than twice the Bitcoin rate. Technicals deteriorating, flows supportive - the same tension behind the 50/50 DCA split.
